exclusion_examples: nickname, initialism, surname spacing or dropped identifying word (unsupported variant)
path naming no part of the client
LILOLU PROPERTIES LLC vs path 'Lilolu Properties Inc' — legal-suffix SUBSTITUTION
inclusion_rules: filing_scope_state resolved and exactly one current ownership scope
zero conflicts of any kind recorded by the preview
proposed category is a real service category (never Client Uploads or Firm Deliverables)
client identity independently corroborated from the source path by the Batch 3 standard: exact_or_reordered, or organization_core for organizations only
owner name has at least two ASCII tokens, so no destination rests on a surname alone
no available client folder carries a legal suffix absent from the stored name (a suffix OMITTED by the path is normalized; a DIFFERENT one substituted is refused)
no available client folder names any other known client, tested against an index built from full_name as well as first/last name forms
all available client folders agree with each other about who the client is
a year folder only where tax_year_confidence is 'strong'; never otherwise
